description: Writes a roster as the site's text export, the official app's layout that tournament organisers and other list builders read, without saving it or needing an account. Takes the shape save_roster takes, such as import_roster's draft or get_my_roster's roster. text is the export; code is a Praetorium exchange code that carries the exact list into Praetorium, or null when the list is too large for one. omittedUnitCount counts entries the current army data no longer prices, which the text leaves out. A name is required. Fails while the army data is unavailable.

roster.description: A complete roster in the shape save_roster takes. Its name must not be empty.

catalogueId.description: Faction catalogue id, as get_unit_options gives it under roster.

detachmentIds.description: Detachment ids, as get_unit_options gives them under roster.

disposition.description: Force disposition id from get_unit_options' roster.dispositions; null when the detachment allows only one.

limit.description: Battle size in points: 1000, 2000 or 3000, or 600 for King of the Colosseum.

picks.description: The units in list order; attachedTo and embarkedIn point at indexes in this list.

attachedTo.description: Index in picks of the unit this leader or support unit joins, one from its list_units canBeLedBy or canBeSupportedBy.

catalogueId.description: The unit's own catalogue when it differs from the roster's; usually omitted.

choices.description: One option per choice group, choice key to option id from get_unit_options, for groups it sets with choices: wargear, an enhancement, a detachment upgrade. Omitted groups keep their default.

embarkedIn.description: Index in picks of the TRANSPORT this unit starts embarked in; set it on the bodyguard unit, never on its attached leader.

entryId.description: Unit id from list_units or get_unit_options.

models.description: Unit size; defaults to the minimum.

spreads.description: How many models take each option of a group get_unit_options sets with spreads: choice key to {option id: count}. A group is in choices or spreads, never both.

toggles.description: Optional single entries by toggle key from get_unit_options, 1 on, 0 off; the Warlord toggle names the army's one Warlord.

prep.description: Chosen stratagems and secondaries; null for none.

name: export_roster
title: Export a roster as text
